narr: A squall line moved through northwestern Arkansas during the early afternoon hours of the 3rd. Damaging wind gusts and localized flash flooding occurred as the storms moved through the area.
ev: Portions of several streets on the north side of Fort Smith were flooded, and several cars were driven into the water and were stalled.
lsr: Street flooding reported on Midland blvd. in Fort Smith.
Cars stalled on 6th St and Midland.
